title: Accounts Payable
description:
Accounts Payable Assistant - Temporary

Location: Hemel Hempstead

Contract: Temporary

We are recruiting for an experienced Accounts Payable Assistant to join a busy finance team in Hemel Hempstead on a temporary basis.

This is a hands-on transactional finance role, supporting the day to day running of the purchase ledger and ensuring supplier invoices and payments are processed accurately and on time.

The Role
- Processing high volumes of supplier invoices, ensuring accuracy and correct authorisation.
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and delivery documentation.
- Investigating invoice discrepancies, price differences and missing information.
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving outstanding queries.
- Managing supplier accounts and responding to payment and invoice enquiries.
- Preparing supplier payment runs and assisting with payment processing.
- Posting invoices, credit notes and adjustments onto the finance system.
- Supporting month-end procedures, including purchase ledger reconciliations and accruals.
- Maintaining accurate supplier records and ensuring invoices are properly documented.
- Providing general support to the wider finance team when required.

About You
- Previous experience working within a busy Accounts Payable or Purchase Ledger function.
- Confident processing supplier invoices and reconciling supplier statements.
- Good understanding of purchase ledger processes.
- Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Comfortable investigating discrepancies and dealing with supplier queries.
- Confident using Excel and finance systems.
- Able to work independently, manage workloads and meet deadlines.
- Available to start a temporary assignment at short notice.

The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity for an immediately available Accounts Payable professional looking to join a busy finance team and make an immediate contribution.

title: Customer Service & Logistics Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Customer Service & Logistics Coordinator

Location: Hemel Hempstead, HP2
Pay Rate: 15.75 per hour
Contract Type: 12-Month (Full-Time)
Hours: Monday - Friday, 37.5 hours per week

The Opportunity
Are you an organised administrator with a knack for keeping orders moving and customers happy? We are recruiting on behalf of a leading global business in Hemel Hempstead (HP2) for a Customer Service & Logistics Coordinator to join their EMEA operations team on a 12-month contract.

In this varied, fast-paced role, you will be the vital link between customers, logistics partners, and internal sales and finance teams across the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands, and Finland.

What you'll be doing
- Order & Logistics Management: Process customer orders and purchase orders from start to finish, liaising with third-party logistics providers to track deliveries and spare parts.
- Customer & Team Support: Act as a key point of contact via phone and email for external customers as well as internal Sales, Finance, and Field Service teams.
- Supply Chain & Stock: Monitor back orders with the supply chain team and update annual customer pricelists on the system.
- Contracts & Queries: Manage annual service contract renewals, resolve invoice queries, and handle customer complaints in line with ISO quality standards.
- Compliance & Documentation: Send out technical product safety documentation (Certificates of Analysis and Safety Data Sheets) and log regulatory field notices when required.

What we're looking for
- Previous experience in customer service, sales order processing, supply chain, or logistics administration.
- Strong IT skills, particularly with ERP/CRM systems and Microsoft Excel, with high attention to detail for data entry and pricing.
- Clear, confident communication skills to coordinate across international teams and resolve queries calmly.
- A degree or equivalent qualification is preferred, though strong relevant industry experience is equally valued.
- Bonus: Any exposure to ISO quality processes, international shipping, or technical/scientific product documentation is a great advantage.
